SELECT Z2.SO_CD , Z2.SO_SEQ , Z2.SO_SERL , Z2.ORD_CDATE , Z2.LOT_NO , Z2.ITEM_CD , Z2.ITEM_CD2 , Z2.ITEM_NM , Z2.CUST_NM , Z2.EUSER_CD , Z2.EUSER_NM , Z2.DEPT_CD , Z2.DEPT_NM , Z2.USER_CD , Z2.USER_NM , Z2.ITEM_LEVEL1 , Z2.ITEM_LEVEL2 , Z2.ITEM_LEVEL3 , Z2.DSTR_TYPE , Z2.DSTR_TYPE_NM , Z2.BIZ_TYPE , Z2.BIZ_TYPE_NM , Z2.ITEM_TYPE , Z2.ITEM_TYPE_NM , Z2.SALES_PDATE , Z2.SALES_DDATE , MAX(Z2.SALES_ODATE) AS SALES_ODATE , Z2.SO_STATUS , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'OPPT_STATUS', Z2.SO_STATUS) AS SO_STATUS_NM , Z2.BASE_CRNY , Z2.EXCH_RATE , MAX(Z2.QTY) AS QTY , MAX(Z2.CUST_SP_QTY) AS CUST_SP_QTY , MAX(Z2.QTY) + MAX(Z2.CUST_SP_QTY) AS TOT_QTY , MAX(Z2.UNIT_PRICE) AS UNIT_PRICE , MAX(Z2.AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT , MAX(Z2.KRW_AMOUNT) AS KRW_AMOUNT , MAX(Z2.SALES_WDATE) AS SALES_WDATE , SUM(Z2.WSO_QTY) AS WSO_QTY , SUM(Z2.WSO_AMOUNT) AS WSO_AMOUNT , SUM(Z2.WSO_KRW_AMOUNT) AS WSO_KRW_AMOUNT , MAX(Z2.OWH_QTY) AS OWH_QTY , MAX(Z2.OWH_AMOUNT) AS OWH_AMOUNT , MAX(Z2.OWH_KRW_AMOUNT) AS OWH_KRW_AMOUNT , Z2.PO_CD , Z2.ORD_GB_L , Z2.ORD_GB_L_NM , Z2.ORD_GB_M , Z2.ORD_GB_M_NM , Z2.ORD_GB_S , Z2.ORD_GB_S_NM , Z2.CTLG_CD , Z2.PJT_CD , Z2.PJT_NM , Z2.CLOSE_YN , Z2.REMARK , Z2.DUMMY8 , Z2.JNB_DEPT_NM FROM ( SELECT Z.COMPANY_CD , Z.SO_CD , Z.SO_SEQ , Z.SO_SERL , Z.ORD_CDATE , Z.LOT_NO , Z.ITEM_CD , Z.ITEM_CD2 , Z.ITEM_NM , Z.CUST_CD , Z.CUST_NM , Z.EUSER_CD , Z.EUSER_NM , Z.DEPT_CD , Z.DEPT_NM , Z.USER_CD , Z.USER_NM , Z.ITEM_LEVEL1 , Z.ITEM_LEVEL2 , Z.ITEM_LEVEL3 , Z.DSTR_TYPE , Z.DSTR_TYPE_NM , Z.BIZ_TYPE , Z.BIZ_TYPE_NM , Z.ITEM_TYPE , Z.ITEM_TYPE_NM , Z.SALES_PDATE , Z.SALES_DDATE , OWH.SALES_ODATE , Z.SO_STATUS , Z.BASE_CRNY , Z.EXCH_RATE , Z.QTY , Z.CUST_SP_QTY , Z.UNIT_PRICE , Z.AMOUNT , Z.KRW_AMOUNT , WSO.SALES_WDATE , WSO.WSO_QTY , WSO.WSO_AMOUNT , WSO.WSO_KRW_AMOUNT , OWH.OWH_QTY , OWH.OWH_AMOUNT , OWH.OWH_KRW_AMOUNT , Z.PO_CD , Z.ORD_GB_L , Z.ORD_GB_L_NM , Z.ORD_GB_M , Z.ORD_GB_M_NM , Z.ORD_GB_S , Z.ORD_GB_S_NM , Z.CTLG_CD , Z.PJT_CD , Z.PJT_NM , Z.CLOSE_YN , Z.REMARK , Z.DUMMY8 , Z.JNB_DEPT_NM FROM ( SELECT LOT_NO , SO_CD , SO_SEQ , SO_SERL , ITEM_CD , SALES_WDATE , SUM(WSO_QTY) AS WSO_QTY , SUM(WSO_AMOUNT) AS WSO_AMOUNT , SUM(WSO_KRW_AMOUNT) AS WSO_KRW_AMOUNT , WSO_YN FROM dbo.T_SO_WSO_AMOUNT WHERE 1=1
AND SALES_WDATE LIKE #year#+#month# +'%'
GROUP BY LOT_NO, SO_CD, SO_SEQ, SO_SERL, ITEM_CD, SALES_WDATE, WSO_YN ) WSO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT LOT_NO , SO_CD , SO_SEQ , SO_SERL , ITEM_CD , MAX(SALES_ODATE) AS SALES_ODATE , SUM(OWH_QTY) AS OWH_QTY , SUM(OWH_AMOUNT) AS OWH_AMOUNT , SUM(OWH_KRW_AMOUNT) AS OWH_KRW_AMOUNT FROM T_SO_OWH_AMOUNT WHERE 1=1
AND SALES_ODATE LIKE #year#+#month# +'%'
GROUP BY LOT_NO, SO_CD, SO_SEQ, SO_SERL, ITEM_CD ) OWH ON WSO.LOT_NO = OWH.LOT_NO AND WSO.SO_CD = OWH.SO_CD AND WSO.SO_SEQ = OWH.SO_SEQ AND WSO.SO_SERL = OWH.SO_SERL AND WSO.ITEM_CD = OWH.ITEM_CD, ( SELECT A.COMPANY_CD , B.SO_CD , B.SO_SEQ , B.SO_SERL , A.ORD_CDATE , B.LOT_NO , B.ITEM_CD , C.ITEM_CD2 , C.ITEM_NM , A.CUST_CD , D.CUST_NM , E.CUST_CD AS EUSER_CD , E.CUST_NM AS EUSER_NM , A.DEPT_CD , F.DEPT_NM , A.USER_CD , dbo.FN_GET_USER_NM(A.USER_CD) AS USER_NM , C.ITEM_LEVEL1 , C.ITEM_LEVEL2 , C.ITEM_LEVEL3 , A.DSTR_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'DSTR_TYPE', A.DSTR_TYPE) AS DSTR_TYPE_NM , A.BIZ_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'BIZ_TYPE', A.BIZ_TYPE) AS BIZ_TYPE_NM , C.ITEM_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'ITEM_TYPE', C.ITEM_TYPE) AS ITEM_TYPE_NM , B.SALES_PDATE , B.SALES_DDATE , A.SO_STATUS , A.BASE_CRNY , A.EXCH_RATE , B.QTY , B.CUST_SP_QTY , B.UNIT_PRICE , B.AMOUNT , B.KRW_AMOUNT , A.PO_CD , B.ORD_GB_L , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'ORDER_GB', B.ORD_GB_L) AS ORD_GB_L_NM , B.ORD_GB_M , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'ORDER_GB', B.ORD_GB_M) AS ORD_GB_M_NM , B.ORD_GB_S , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'ORDER_GB', B.ORD_GB_S) AS ORD_GB_S_NM , B.CTLG_CD , A.PJT_CD , (SELECT PJT_NM FROM T_PROJECT WHERE PJT_CD = A.PJT_CD) AS PJT_NM , B.CLOSE_YN , B.REMARK , B.DUMMY8 , B.JNB_DEPT_NM FROM dbo.T_SALES_ORDER A, dbo.T_SO_CNTR_AMOUNT B, dbo.T_ITEM C, dbo.T_CUSTOMER D, dbo.T_CUSTOMER E, dbo.T_DEPARTMENT F WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = B.COMPANY_CD AND A.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.COMPANY_CD = E.COMPANY_CD AND A.COMPANY_CD = F.COMPANY_CD AND A.SO_CD = B.SO_CD AND A.SO_SEQ = B.SO_SEQ AND B.ITEM_CD = C.ITEM_CD AND A.CUST_CD = D.CUST_CD AND A.EUSER_CD = E.CUST_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = F.DEPT_CD
AND F.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
) Z WHERE 1=1 AND WSO.SO_CD = Z.SO_CD AND WSO.SO_SEQ = Z.SO_SEQ AND WSO.SO_SERL = Z.SO_SERL ) Z2 WHERE Z2.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND Z2.SO_CD IS NOT NULL
AND (DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(Z2.SALES_PDATE, 'YYYYMM') < #year#+#month# OR DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(Z2.SALES_PDATE, 'YYYYMM') >= #year#+#month# )
AND DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(Z2.SALES_PDATE, 'YYYYMM') < #year#+#month#
AND DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(Z2.SALES_PDATE, 'YYYYMM') >= #year#+#month#
AND Z2.SO_CD = #so_cd#
AND Z2.SO_SEQ = #so_seq#
AND Z2.LOT_NO = #lot_no#
AND Z2.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND Z2.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND Z2.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
AND (Z2.CUST_CD LIKE '%'+ #cust_nm# +'%' OR Z2.CUST_NM LIKE '%'+ #cust_nm# +'%')
AND Z2.CUST_CD = #cust_cd#
AND Z2.BIZ_TYPE = #biz_type#
AND Z2.CTLG_CD LIKE '%'+ #ctlg_cd# +'%'
AND (Z2.EUSER_CD LIKE '%'+ #euser_nm# +'%' OR Z2.EUSER_NM LIKE '%'+ #euser_nm# +'%')
AND Z2.EUSER_CD = #euser_cd#
AND Z2.ITEM_TYPE = #item_type#
AND Z2.ITEM_NM LIKE '%'+ #item_nm# +'%'
AND Z2.SO_STATUS = #oppt_status#
AND Z2.CUST_CD IN (SELECT CUST_CD FROM T_CUSTOMER WHERE BCUST_CD LIKE '%'+ #bcust_nm# +'%' OR DBO.FN_GET_BCUST_NM(BCUST_CD) LIKE '%'+ #bcust_nm# +'%')
AND Z2.CUST_CD IN (SELECT CUST_CD FROM T_CUSTOMER WHERE BCUST_CD LIKE '%'+ #bcust_cd# +'%')
AND Z2.PJT_CD = #pjt_cd#
AND Z2.PO_CD LIKE '%'+ #po_cd# +'%'
AND Z2.ITEM_LEVEL1 = #item_level1#
AND Z2.ITEM_LEVEL2 = #item_level2#
AND Z2.ITEM_LEVEL3 = #item_level3#
AND Z2.ORD_GB_L = #ord_gb_l#
AND Z2.ORD_GB_M = #ord_gb_m#
AND Z2.ORD_GB_S = #ord_gb_s#
AND Z2.ORD_CDATE LIKE '#ord_cdate#' +'%'
GROUP BY Z2.SO_CD , Z2.SO_SEQ , Z2.SO_SERL , Z2.ORD_CDATE , Z2.LOT_NO , Z2.ITEM_CD , Z2.ITEM_CD2 , Z2.ITEM_NM , Z2.CUST_NM , Z2.EUSER_CD , Z2.EUSER_NM , Z2.DEPT_CD , Z2.DEPT_NM , Z2.USER_CD , Z2.USER_NM , Z2.ITEM_LEVEL1 , Z2.ITEM_LEVEL2 , Z2.ITEM_LEVEL3 , Z2.DSTR_TYPE , Z2.DSTR_TYPE_NM , Z2.BIZ_TYPE , Z2.BIZ_TYPE_NM , Z2.ITEM_TYPE , Z2.ITEM_TYPE_NM , Z2.SALES_PDATE , Z2.SALES_DDATE , Z2.SO_STATUS , Z2.BASE_CRNY , Z2.EXCH_RATE , Z2.PO_CD , Z2.ORD_GB_L , Z2.ORD_GB_L_NM , Z2.ORD_GB_M , Z2.ORD_GB_M_NM , Z2.ORD_GB_S , Z2.ORD_GB_S_NM , Z2.CTLG_CD , Z2.PJT_CD , Z2.PJT_NM , Z2.CLOSE_YN , Z2.REMARK , Z2.DUMMY8 , Z2.JNB_DEPT_NM ORDER BY ORD_CDATE ASC

, DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(Z2.SALES_PDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SALES_PDATE , DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(Z2.SALES_DDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SALES_DDATE , DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(MAX(Z2.SALES_ODATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD') Z.ITEM_CD , Z.ITEM_CD2 , Z.ITEM_NM , Z.CUST_CD , Z.CUST_NM , Z.EUSER_CD , Z.EUSER_NM , Z.DEPT_CD , Z.DEPT_NM , Z.USER_CD , Z.USER_NM , Z.ITEM_LEVEL1 , Z.ITEM_LEVEL2 , Z.ITEM_LEVEL3 , Z.DSTR_TYPE , Z.DSTR_TYPE_NM , Z.BIZ_TYPE , Z.BIZ_TYPE_NM , Z.ITEM_TYPE , Z.ITEM_TYPE_NM , Z.SALES_PDATE , Z.SALES_DDATE , OWH.SALES_ODATE , Z.SO_STATUS , Z.BASE_CRNY , Z.EXCH_RATE , Z.QTY , Z.CUST_SP_QTY , Z.UNIT_PRICE , Z.AMOUNT , Z.KRW_AMOUNT , WSO.SALES_WDATE , WSO.WSO_QTY , WSO.WSO_AMOUNT , WSO.WSO_KRW_AMOUNT , OWH.OWH_QTY , OWH.OWH_AMOUNT , OWH.OWH_KRW_AMOUNT , Z.PO_CD , Z.ORD_GB_L , Z.ORD_GB_L_NM , Z.ORD_GB_M , Z.ORD_GB_M_NM , Z.ORD_GB_S , Z.ORD_GB_S_NM , Z.CTLG_CD , Z.PJT_CD , Z.PJT_NM , Z.CLOSE_YN FROM ( SELECT LOT_NO , SO_CD , SO_SEQ , SO_SERL , ITEM_CD , SALES_WDATE , SUM(WSO_QTY) AS WSO_QTY , SUM(WSO_AMOUNT) AS WSO_AMOUNT , SUM(WSO_KRW_AMOUNT) AS WSO_KRW_AMOUNT , WSO_YN FROM dbo.T_SO_WSO_AMOUNT WHERE 1=1
AND SALES_WDATE LIKE #year#+#month# +'%'
GROUP BY LOT_NO, SO_CD, SO_SEQ, SO_SERL, ITEM_CD, SALES_WDATE, WSO_YN ) WSO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT LOT_NO , SO_CD , SO_SEQ , SO_SERL , ITEM_CD , MAX(SALES_ODATE) AS SALES_ODATE , SUM(OWH_QTY) AS OWH_QTY , SUM(OWH_AMOUNT) AS OWH_AMOUNT , SUM(OWH_KRW_AMOUNT) AS OWH_KRW_AMOUNT FROM T_SO_OWH_AMOUNT WHERE 1=1
AND SALES_ODATE LIKE #year#+#month# +'%'
GROUP BY LOT_NO, SO_CD, SO_SEQ, SO_SERL, ITEM_CD ) OWH ON WSO.LOT_NO = OWH.LOT_NO AND WSO.SO_CD = OWH.SO_CD AND WSO.SO_SEQ = OWH.SO_SEQ AND WSO.SO_SERL = OWH.SO_SERL AND WSO.ITEM_CD = OWH.ITEM_CD, ( SELECT A.COMPANY_CD , B.SO_CD , B.SO_SEQ , B.SO_SERL , A.ORD_CDATE , B.LOT_NO , B.ITEM_CD , C.ITEM_CD2 , C.ITEM_NM , A.CUST_CD , D.CUST_NM , E.CUST_CD AS EUSER_CD , E.CUST_NM AS EUSER_NM , A.DEPT_CD , F.DEPT_NM , A.USER_CD , dbo.FN_GET_USER_NM(A.USER_CD) AS USER_NM , C.ITEM_LEVEL1 , C.ITEM_LEVEL2 , C.ITEM_LEVEL3 , A.DSTR_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'DSTR_TYPE', A.DSTR_TYPE) AS DSTR_TYPE_NM , A.BIZ_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'BIZ_TYPE', A.BIZ_TYPE) AS BIZ_TYPE_NM , C.ITEM_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'ITEM_TYPE', C.ITEM_TYPE) AS ITEM_TYPE_NM , B.SALES_PDATE , B.SALES_DDATE , A.SO_STATUS , A.BASE_CRNY , A.EXCH_RATE , B.QTY , B.CUST_SP_QTY , B.UNIT_PRICE , B.AMOUNT , B.KRW_AMOUNT , A.PO_CD , B.ORD_GB_L , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'ORDER_GB', B.ORD_GB_L) AS ORD_GB_L_NM , B.ORD_GB_M , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'ORDER_GB', B.ORD_GB_M) AS ORD_GB_M_NM , B.ORD_GB_S , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'ORDER_GB', B.ORD_GB_S) AS ORD_GB_S_NM , B.CTLG_CD , A.PJT_CD , (SELECT PJT_NM FROM T_PROJECT WHERE PJT_CD = A.PJT_CD) AS PJT_NM , B.CLOSE_YN , B.REMARK , B.DUMMY8 , B.JNB_DEPT_NM FROM dbo.T_SALES_ORDER A, dbo.T_SO_CNTR_AMOUNT B, dbo.T_ITEM C, dbo.T_CUSTOMER D, dbo.T_CUSTOMER E, dbo.T_DEPARTMENT F WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = B.COMPANY_CD AND A.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.COMPANY_CD = E.COMPANY_CD AND A.COMPANY_CD = F.COMPANY_CD AND A.SO_CD = B.SO_CD AND A.SO_SEQ = B.SO_SEQ AND B.ITEM_CD = C.ITEM_CD AND A.CUST_CD = D.CUST_CD AND A.EUSER_CD = E.CUST_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = F.DEPT_CD ) Z WHERE 1=1 AND WSO.SO_CD = Z.SO_CD AND WSO.SO_SEQ = Z.SO_SEQ AND WSO.SO_SERL = Z.SO_SERL ) Z2 WHERE Z2.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND Z2.SO_CD IS NOT NULL

statements.update: UPDATE T_SALES_ORDER SET PJT_CD = #pjt_cd# , MOD_DT = GETDATE() , MOD_USR = #mod_usr# WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND SO_CD = #so_cd#
UPDATE T_SO_CNTR_AMOUNT SET CLOSE_YN = #close_yn# , MOD_DT = GETDATE() , MOD_USR = #mod_usr# WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND SO_CD = #so_cd# AND SO_SEQ = #so_seq# AND SO_SERL = #so_serl#
statements.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY OWH_NO ASC) AS ROWNUM , A.SO_CD , A.SO_SEQ , A.SO_SERL , A.INV_SEQ , A.INV_SERL , A.LOT_NO , A.OWH_NO , A.ITEM_CD , (SELECT ITEM_CD2 FROM T_ITEM WHERE ITEM_CD = A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_CD2 , DBO.FN_GET_ITEM_NM(A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_NM , (SELECT BASE_CRNY FROM T_SALES_ORDER WHERE SO_CD = A.SO_CD) AS BASE_CRNY , A.EXCH_RATE , A.OWH_QTY , A.OWH_UNIT_PRICE , A.OWH_AMOUNT , A.OWH_KRW_AMOUNT , DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(A.SALES_ODATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SALES_ODATE FROM T_SO_OWH_AMOUNT A WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.SO_CD = #so_cd# AND A.SO_SEQ = #so_seq# AND A.LOT_NO = #lot_no# ORDER BY ROWNUM ASC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ITEM_CD ASC) AS ROWNUM , A.ITEM_CD , (SELECT ITEM_CD2 FROM T_ITEM WHERE ITEM_CD = A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_CD2 , DBO.FN_GET_ITEM_NM(A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_NM , (SELECT BASE_CRNY FROM T_SALES_ORDER WHERE SO_CD = A.SO_CD) AS BASE_CRNY , A.EXCH_RATE , A.BILL_QTY , A.BILL_UNIT_PRICE , A.BILL_AMOUNT , A.BILL_KRW_AMOUNT , DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(A.SALES_BDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SALES_BDATE FROM T_SO_BILL_AMOUNT A WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.SO_CD = #so_cd# AND A.SO_SEQ = #so_seq# AND A.LOT_NO = #lot_no# ORDER BY SALES_BDATE ASC
